Shri Surendra Singh - Senior Advocate with Shri P.K. Vaishy
 Advocate for applicant.
Smt. Geeta Yadav - Govt. Advocate for respondent-State.
Shri R.P. Singh - Advocate for Objector.

Order 
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.) seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR/Crime No.1487/2024 dated 13.11.2024 registered at Police Station Waidan District Singrauli for the offences punishable under Section 376(2)
(n) of IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that as per the prosecution, the applicant and the prosecutrix were known to each other and according to the prosecutrix, first time there was physical relationship on 18.06.2018 and then the applicant continued to NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:60650 2 MCRC-51095-2024 commit the offence under the garb of false promise of marriage.
Later on, the engagement of the applicant was solemnized elsewhere thereafter the report has been lodged.
It is contended by the counsel that the prosecutrix is major and the past record of the applicant is unblemished.
Thus, counsel submits that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent as well as Objector have opposed the prayer and submitted that the present applicant persuaded the prosecutrix to have physical relationship under the garb of false promise of marriage, therefore, the report has been lodged as regards the aforesaid offence.
Thus counsel submits that the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5.
A perusal of case diary reflects that the applicant and the prosecutrix were known to each other and they had physical relationship as well.
The prosecutrix is major.
6. Thus, taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest the applicant shall be NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:60650 3 MCRC-51095-2024 enlarged on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of the BNSS.
9.
Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
